subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally park owner-ambiguous legacy outbox rows for manual re-entry or deletion rather than attempting automatic replay under the newly resolved chat owner?
rationale: Tests can prove the implementation behaves as designed, but they cannot decide whether stopping legacy automatic delivery and requiring visible operator action is the intended upgrade contract.

options.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
options.body: Accept the safer manual-recovery behavior, then require exact-head fresh-install and version-4-to-8 upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Design a narrower migration
options.body: Hold the PR until a provably safe migration can assign legacy rows to an original owner without guessing or replaying them into the wrong chat.

options.title: Pause persisted recovery changes
options.body: Land only the transient composer-owner fix later if maintainers do not want to change durable outbox and cache upgrade behavior in this release.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Accept the safer manual-recovery behavior, then require exact-head fresh-install and version-4-to-8 upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision concerns Android user-visible recovery and persisted app-state semantics, and the Android README identifies this account as the app owner.
